# Configuration reference

The application is configured with environment variables. A `.env` file in the working
directory is read at startup; variables set in the real environment take precedence.
Invalid values are reported together and the process exits before serving traffic.

## Application

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `APP_NAME` | `go-rest-template` | Service name used in logs, token issuer and traces. |
| `APP_ENV` | `development` | Runtime environment. Production tightens defaults and refuses insecure settings. One of: development, production. |
| `APP_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT` | `10s` | Maximum time to wait for in-flight requests on shutdown. |

## HTTP server

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `HTTP_HOST` | `0.0.0.0` | Interface the API listens on. |
| `HTTP_PORT` | `8080` | Port the API listens on. |
| `HTTP_READ_TIMEOUT` | `5s` | Maximum time to read a request, including the body. |
| `HTTP_WRITE_TIMEOUT` | `10s` | Maximum time to write a response. |
| `HTTP_IDLE_TIMEOUT` | `1m0s` | Maximum time to keep an idle keep-alive connection open. |
| `HTTP_REQUEST_TIMEOUT` | `30s` | Deadline applied to the context of every request. |
| `HTTP_TRUSTED_PROXIES` | `0` | Number of reverse proxies in front of the API whose X-Forwarded-For entries are trusted. 0 uses the TCP peer address. |
| `HTTP_MAX_BODY_BYTES` | `1048576` | Maximum accepted request body size in bytes. |
| `HTTP_CORS_ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | `*` | Comma-separated origins allowed by CORS. Use explicit origins in production. |

## Admin server

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `ADMIN_HOST` | `0.0.0.0` | Interface the admin server (metrics, profiling) listens on. Keep it off the public network. |
| `ADMIN_PORT` | `9090` | Port of the admin server. 0 disables it. |
| `ADMIN_PPROF_ENABLED` | `false` | Expose net/http/pprof under /debug/pprof on the admin server. |

## Authentication

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `AUTH_ALGORITHM` | `HS256` | Access token signing algorithm. EdDSA publishes the public key at /.well-known/jwks.json. One of: HS256, EdDSA. |
| `AUTH_SECRET` | `change-me-in-production` | HMAC signing key for HS256. At least 32 characters in production. |
| `AUTH_PRIVATE_KEY_FILE` | — | Path to a PEM-encoded PKCS#8 Ed25519 private key. Required for EdDSA. |
| `AUTH_ISSUER` | `go-rest-template` | Value of the iss claim. Defaults to APP_NAME. |
| `AUTH_ACCESS_TOKEN_TTL` | `15m0s` | Lifetime of access tokens. |
| `AUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN_TTL` | `720h0m0s` | Lifetime of refresh tokens. |
| `AUTH_BCRYPT_COST` | `12` | bcrypt work factor, between 10 and 16. |
| `AUTH_REGISTRATION_ENABLED` | `true` | Allow anonymous callers to create regular user accounts. |

## Database

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `DATABASE_DRIVER` | `sqlite` | Database backend. Defaults to sqlite in development and postgres in production. One of: sqlite, postgres. |
| `DATABASE_URL` | — | PostgreSQL connection string. Required when DATABASE_DRIVER=postgres. |
| `SQLITE_PATH` | `data/app.db` | SQLite database file. Used when DATABASE_DRIVER=sqlite. |
| `DATABASE_AUTO_MIGRATE` | `true` | Apply pending migrations at startup. |
| `DATABASE_MAX_OPEN_CONNS` | `20` | Maximum open connections (PostgreSQL). |
| `DATABASE_MAX_IDLE_CONNS` | `5` | Maximum idle connections (PostgreSQL). |
| `DATABASE_CONN_MAX_IDLE_TIME` | `5m0s` | Maximum time a connection may stay idle (PostgreSQL). |
| `DATABASE_CONN_MAX_LIFETIME` | `1h0m0s` | Maximum time a connection may be reused (PostgreSQL). |

## Bootstrap

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_ENABLED` | `false` | Create an administrator at startup when none exists. |
| `BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_USERNAME` | — | Username of the bootstrap administrator. |
| `BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_FIRST_NAME` | — | First name of the bootstrap administrator. |
| `BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_LAST_NAME` | — | Last name of the bootstrap administrator. |
| `BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD` | — | Password of the bootstrap administrator, at least 12 characters. |

## OpenAPI

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `OPENAPI_VALIDATE_REQUESTS` | `true` | Reject requests that do not match the OpenAPI contract. |
| `OPENAPI_VALIDATE_RESPONSES` | `true` | Fail responses that do not match the contract. Buffers every response, so it defaults to true in development and false in production. |
| `OPENAPI_DOCS_ENABLED` | `true` | Serve the interactive API reference at /docs. |

## Rate limiting

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `RATE_LIMIT_ENABLED` | `true` | Throttle requests per client IP. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_REQUESTS` | `100` | Requests allowed per client IP in each window. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW` | `1m0s` | Length of the rate limit window. |
| `RATE_LIMIT_LOGIN_REQUESTS` | `10` | Login and token refresh attempts allowed per client IP in each window. |

## Logging

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `LOG_LEVEL` | `INFO` | Minimum level of emitted log records. One of: DEBUG, INFO, WARN, ERROR. |
| `LOG_FORMAT` | `auto` | Log encoding. auto selects text in development and json in production. One of: auto, text, json. |

## Metrics

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `METRICS_ENABLED` | `true` | Expose Prometheus metrics at /metrics on the admin server. |

## Tracing

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `OTEL_ENABLED` | `false` | Export OpenTelemetry traces over OTLP/HTTP. The endpoint is set with OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT. |
| `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME` | `go-rest-template` | Service name reported in traces. Defaults to APP_NAME. |
